summary: The docs pass before the fast-apps merge. The rules a next coder needs (origin and layers, the sub app folder and testing rules, the hold, a run never writes a shared object, a birth that makes what's asked, Tools/Bench, the packages and SDK, the rebase trap) are in a new apps.md with file:line checked at the tip. The three CLAUDE.md proposals are applied. CLAUDE.md names none of the removed members; architecture.md named two (fixed); the plan's start.md contradicted the code in five places (fixed, stage 6 added). Documentation, CLAUDE.md and the plan only: no production code, no .pr, no teaching markdown.
